italien.title: File:Varenna, Lake Como 1.jpg
italien.author: Ray in Manila
italien.changes: Verkleinert und in WebP komprimiert; im Layout teilweise beschnitten.
italien.description: PUBLISHED: www.thetravelmagazine.net/unique-travel-experiences-from-... Varenna is a commune on Lake Como in the Province of Lecco in the Italian region Lombardy, located about 60 kilometres north of Milan and about 20 kilometres northwest of Lecco. Varenna was founded by local fishermen in 769, and was later allied of the commune of Milan. In 1126 it was destroyed by the rival commune of Como, and later received the refugees from the Isola Comacina, who had met the same fate (1169).

luzern-breit.title: File:CH.LU.Luzern Kapellbrücke 01 16x9-R 16384x9216.jpg
luzern-breit.author: Roy Egloff
luzern-breit.changes: Verkleinert und in WebP komprimiert; im Layout teilweise beschnitten.
luzern-breit.description: Chapel Bridge, a covered wooden footbridge spanning the river Reuss in the city of Lucerne in central Switzerland. Named after the nearby St. Peter's Chapel, the bridge is unique in containing a number of interior paintings dating back to the 17th century, although many of them were destroyed along with a larger part of the centuries-old bridge in a 1993 fire. Subsequently restored, the Kapellbrücke is the oldest wooden covered bridge in Europe, as well as the world's oldest surviving truss bridge.
